Bubble quick action: in Setup → "Bubble tap", pick a button (Reveal, Hint, Cat, X or Answer). Tapping the minimized bubble then runs it directly; long-press the bubble to open the panel. Default "Open" keeps the old behaviour.

Install: download **MeowSolver-v2.4.apk** below, then follow the Setup steps in the README. Android 11+. If Android refuses to update over an older version, uninstall the old app first.

Source: see README for build steps.
